AddProductHint: Only this supplier's products. Search by name or scan a barcode, then pick it; picking it again adds one to its row.
CancelExplain: This takes the received quantities back out of stock and removes {{total}} from what the shop owes the supplier. It cannot be undone.
CancelPaidWarning: {{paid}} was paid when the goods came in. The payment stays in the supplier's ledger, so the supplier will then owe the shop that amount.
Cancelled: {{number}} cancelled. Stock and the supplier's balance were put back.
CancelledNote: This purchase was cancelled: its stock was taken back out and it no longer counts towards what is owed.
EmptyHint: When goods arrive from a supplier, record them here to add them to stock.
ErrCost: Enter a cost for every product (0 or more).
ErrDate: Choose the day the goods arrived (not in the future).
ErrPaid: The amount paid cannot be more than the total.
ErrQuantity: Every product needs a quantity above zero.
LedgerNote: Stock was increased when this was saved. The amount left to pay was added to the supplier's balance.
NoLinesYet: No products yet. Search above to add the goods that arrived.
PayFromDrawer: Take the payment from the cash drawer
PayFromDrawerHint: The paid amount is taken off the cash expected in your drawer.
DrawerClosedHint: Your cash drawer is not open, so nothing is taken from it. Open the drawer first to pay from it.
PaidNowHint: What you paid the supplier on the spot. The rest goes on their account.
SaveHint: Saving adds the quantities to stock right away.
SearchPlaceholder: Search by number, supplier or invoice no.
SupplierCurrencyHint: Prices on this purchase are in {{currency}}, the supplier's currency.
SupplierReferenceHint: The number on the supplier's own invoice or delivery note.
UpdateCost: Also set as the product's cost price
UpdateCostConverted: Also set as cost price (converted to the product's currency)
NoPurchasesYet: No purchases from this supplier yet.
